original.target_description: Median RT local switch cost ANOVA: main effect of language status (monolingual versus bilingual), averaged over switch status.

n.sample_role: Participants in median-RT repeated-measures ANOVA; final analytic count not explicitly printed.
n.exclusions: Two monolingual participants removed for error rates in a cell greater than 25%; only correct-response trials preceded by a correct response entered analyses.
n.location: Participants, printed p. 2; Results and Table 1, printed p. 4
n.quote: Sixty-eight young adults (44 female; M = 19.1 years ... old; 37 monolinguals) participated in exchange for ... a correct response trial were included in analyses. Two ... participants (both monolingual) were removed because of ... error rates in a cell greater than 25%. No other error rate ... or RT outliers were detected based on normality tests and ... observation of histograms and box plots.

es.quote: Neither the language status main effect nor the interaction ... reached significance, Fs < 1. Analysis using mean RTs

p.quote: Neither the language status main effect nor the interaction ... reached significance, Fs < 1. Analysis using mean RTs

notes: Identity verified internally: title Flexibility in task switching by monolinguals and bilinguals; authors Melody Wiseheart, Mythili Viswanathan and Ellen Bialystok; DOI 10.1017/S1366728914000273; Cambridge FirstView primary research article, published online 29 December 2014, printed pages 1–6. Supplied text includes methods, results, discussion and references, rather than an abstract-only excerpt. No PDF was supplied. Input locators p. 5/p. 6 correspond to printed article pp. 4/5 when counting the cover page. The source gives 68 recruited participants (37 monolinguals, 31 bilinguals in Table 1) and removes two monolingual participants for cell error rates >25%, but does not explicitly print the final critical-model analytic N or mutually exclusive final group counts. Recruitment totals are not final group counts; analytic N is left null under the assigned completion rule. Candidate accounting only, not an extracted analytic N: 68 recruited − 2 excluded = 66; 37 recruited monolinguals − 2 excluded = 35, with 31 recruited bilinguals. These final group counts are derived rather than printed. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom. Median RT is the explicitly reported critical analysis; mean RT analyses are described as an identical pattern with nearly identical F-values, without separate printed statistics. The corresponding test prints only F < 1 (jointly Fs < 1 for the two local-cost effects); no numerical p or partial eta-squared is reported for this effect. The printed F bound is retained without converting to an effect size or p value.
